credits.title: Sisters
credits.overview: Two sisters bring their families together for a summer weekend near Madrid to celebrate milestones and the San Juan Festival. The celebration turns dark when a child makes a serious sexual abuse allegation.

credits.title: Las Hurdes, a Land with Soul
credits.overview: A modern answer to Luis Buñuel's mythical documentary “Land Without Bread” (1933) about Las Hurdes, a historically impoverished region of the province of Cáceres, in Extremadura, Spain, and also a journey of discovery of the soul of this beautiful land and its inhabitants.

credits.title: Gay Art Seeking a Home
credits.overview: In 2005 the NGO Cultural Association Visible in Madrid begins to create a collection of gay-themed art (LGBT), with works donated by artists from around the world. credits.title: Inseparable From You
credits.overview: A short movie starring Najwa Nimri addressing the complex world of mental illness and more specifically the bipolar disorder.

credits.title: The Basque Ball: Skin Against Stone
credits.overview: An attempt to create a bridge between the different political positions that coexist, sometimes violently, in the Basque Country, in northern Spain.
